name: Hasini Yedla
motivation: As a Commercial Strategy & External Affairs Associate, I want to understand how innovative ideas are transformed into sustainable businesses. During my early college days, I was someone who preferred staying in the background and hesitated to step forward. However, the opportunities I took up gradually helped me become more confident, communicate with people, and learn the value of stepping outside my comfort zone. Those experiences motivated me to continue challenging myself and seek opportunities that contribute to my personal and professional growth. I chose this role because it aligns with my interest in understanding how business decisions are made, how customer needs are identified, and how effective communication connects ideas with the right people. I also want to gain real-world experience by learning alongside my teammates and mentors.
expectations: I don't expect E-Cell to teach me everything about startups in a short time. What I do expect is an opportunity to understand how businesses actually think and make decisions. Since I chose the Commercial Strategy & External Affairs role, I want to learn how customer requirements are understood, how business ideas are discussed and validated, and how communication plays an important role in connecting business and technical teams. As someone who wants to build a career where I can work between business and technology, I hope this experience gives me practical exposure and helps me develop the mindset and skills needed to approach real-world problems with a broader perspective.
